crossCuttingInference: JPEG quantization reliably describes the current JPEG encoding, not all prior history.
Phase can retain information better than magnitude in a reported compressed-detector regime, but Lythaus has no reproduction yet.
Most unseen-generator methods improve only under the source/data distribution and do not establish Seedream-4 or Imagen-4 transfer.
A deterministic eligibility inspector is lower-risk and cheaper than immediately adding another neural checkpoint.
SAFE-B should remain a future experiment: frozen SAFE-A plus an independent head or objective, never overwrite SAFE-A.
